Uncle Fabrizio: David Proval. Jim: Bruce Thomas. Jacques Du Jacques: Andy Lauer.

programme.desc: Rachel, a NYC appraiser is sent to a small town to buy out a library so her client can build a resort. She meets Jake, a local writer who tries to convince her how important the library is to the small community but the arrival of his niece and nephew complicate his efforts.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Captains Courageous
programme.desc: Rudyard Kipling's tale about a spoiled heir (Kenny Vadas) who learns the value of friendship and work when he's rescued at sea by fishermen and forced to earn his keep. Capt. Troop: Robert Urich. Dan: Kaj-Erik Eriksen. Wade: Robert Wisden. Mrs. Troop: Sandra Nelson. Michael Anderson directed.

programme.title: Undercover Bridesmaid
programme.desc: A security agent goes undercover as a bridesmaid in order to protect a bride-to-be who's been receiving threatening letters leading up to her nuptials. As the agent works the case, she also forms a bond with a groomsman and learns a lesson about forgiveness.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: The Cookie Mobster
programme.desc: A young mob member goes into the Witness Protection Program and settles into a quiet suburban village, where he falls for a local woman and gets involved with cookie-making fund-raising for her daughter's scout troop while dodging his former associates who have tracked him down.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious
programme.desc: A disgraced chef and an ambitious cardiologist who can't even boil water cross paths when she takes his cooking class. Now she must convince the hot-headed chef to teach her hospital's new Healthy Living seminars, but he has another idea.

programme.title: Family Plan
programme.desc: Charlie MacKenzie is a dedicated career woman who must lie about having a family in order to land her dream job. Charlie gets the job, but when her new boss moves in next door, Charlie must hire an actor to play her husband and borrow her best friend's teenage daughter to act as her own child.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Legally Tender
programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Avalanche visit the Stars for Game 1 of their first-round series. Dallas ended the regular season on a seven-game slide. Colorado's Nathan MacKinnon shared the NHL lead with 84 assists. The Stars eliminated the Avs in the West semifinals in 2024.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The injury-depleted Stars try to tie up their first-round series with the Avalanche entering Game 2. Without key players Jason Robertson and Miro Heiskanen, Dallas couldn't stop Colorado's attack in Game 1, falling 5-1. Nathan MacKinnon scored twice.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The rejuvenated Stars visit the Avalanche for Game 3 of their West quarterfinal. Dallas evened the series 1-1 with a 4-3 victory in Game 2 on Colin Blackwell's goal at 17:46 of overtime. Nathan MacKinnon (COL) has tallied three times this series.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Stars visit the Avalanche for Game 4 of a West quarterfinal. Colorado's Gabriel Landeskog played for the first time since June 26, 2022, but Dallas spoiled the party on Tyler Seguin's goal at 5:31 of overtime in Game 3 to take a 2-1 series lead.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: Gabriel Landeskog's Avalanche visit the Stars for a pivotal Game 5 of their Western Conference quarterfinal. Landeskog recorded a goal and an assist, and Mackenzie Blackwood made 23 saves as Colorado evened the series with a 4-0 victory in Game 4.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Avalanche try to stay alive as they return to the Rockies for Game 6 of their West first-round set with the Stars. Wyatt Johnston scored nine seconds into Game 5, finishing with two goals and an assist as Dallas rolled to a 6-2 decision.

programme.title: NHL Hockey No subtitle
programme.desc: The Avalanche visit the Stars for Game 7 of their West quarterfinal series. Colorado forced a deciding showdown with a 7-4 victory in Game 6 behind Nathan MacKinnon's go-ahead goal in the third period. Dallas coach Peter DeBoer is 8-0 in Game 7s.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Squidward and SpongeBob plan a talent show; SpongeBob thinks Plankton is lonely.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob suspects Patrick of stealing his jellyfishing net; SpongeBob builds a ventriloquist dummy modeled after Squidward.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to convince a bouncer that he is tough enough for the Salty Spitoon; Squidward's archenemy returns.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Treats!; For Here or to Go

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The place where Plankton usually dumps his rotten chum is too full, so he tricks SpongeBob into hiding it around the city; SpongeBob befriends a small storm cloud but has to protect it from a crazed weatherman.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Growth Spout; Stuck in the Wringer

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Krusty Towers; Mrs. Puff, You're Fired

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Plankton's giant Chum Bucket glove runs wild in town, but SpongeBob has a handy friend to help them out; SpongeBob takes his first break ever at work.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.sub-title: Someone's in the Kitchen With Sandy; The Inside Job
programme.desc: Plankton steals Sandy's pelt to impersonate her; Plankton tries to launch himself into Mr. Krabs' head and misses his target.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs interferes with Pearl's slumber party preparations; SpongeBob decides to give Gary a makeover before entering him in a pet show.

programme.title: I Am: Joe Frazier

programme.title: Stonehenge Apocalypse
programme.desc: Archaeologists digging near Stonehenge accidentally activate an ancient piece of machinery underneath the bedrock that could end the world.

programme.title: Kina & Yuk
programme.desc: Two foxes are preparing to become parents for the first time while global warming is altering the rules for everyone.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson: Black + White
programme.desc: A celebration of the life and career of Oscar Peterson, one of Canada's greatest jazz musicians and a master pianist.

programme.title: Behemoth
programme.desc: After an earthquake wakes a giant creature trapped in a mountain, residents have to find a way to kill it before it destroys the entire town.

programme.title: Super Storm
programme.desc: A high-school student creates a science project that holds the key to saving the Earth from devastating cyclones.

programme.title: Metal Shifters
programme.desc: After a meteorite crashes to Earth, a bacteria is released that kills humans on contact. When the bacteria latches on to an iron statue, it brings the statue to life to send it on a destructive rampage.

programme.title: Polar Storm
programme.desc: A scientist must save the day when violent storms threaten Earth's magnetic poles.

programme.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
programme.desc: Optimus Prime and the Autobots take on their biggest challenge yet. When a new threat capable of destroying the entire planet emerges, they must team up with a powerful faction of Transformers known as the Maximals to save Earth.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: A seasoned showgirl must plan for her future when her show abruptly closes after a 30-year run.

programme.title: Daddio
programme.desc: A woman gets into a taxi at New York airport and gradually tells the driver about her unfortunate decisions that led to an affair with a married man; the driver also reveals more and more about his life.

programme.title: Bagman
programme.desc: A father faces a childhood threat that resurfaces suddenly. He battles his deepest fear, not for himself, but to protect his family from the sinister danger.

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter
programme.desc: Kraven's complex relationship with his ruthless father starts him down a path of vengeance, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

programme.title: The Blind
programme.desc: In 1960s Louisiana, future "Duck Dynasty" star Phil Robertson falls in love and starts a family, but his demons soon threaten to tear everyone apart. As he seeks to conquer the shame of his past, he ultimately finds redemption in an unlikely place.

programme.title: Toxic Skies
programme.desc: A doctor must find a cure for a viral epidemic that is spreading through vapors from jets.

programme.title: Ailey
programme.desc: Filmmaker Jamila Wignot examines the life of visionary dancer and choreographer Alvin Ailey.

programme.title: Paddington in Peru
programme.desc: Paddington and the Brown family stumble across a legendary treasure as they embark on a thrilling quest through the rainforests of the Amazon to find his beloved aunt.

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: Cat is a solitary animal, but as its home is devastated by a great flood, he finds refuge on a boat populated by various species, and will have to team up with them despite their differences.

programme.title: My Penguin Friend
programme.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programme.title: My Penguin Friend
programme.desc: A heartbroken fisherman finds a penguin drifting alone in the ocean, drenched in oil from a spill. He not only rescues the sea creature, but takes it under his wing, finding a sense of joy for the first time in years.

programme.title: The Addams Family 2
programme.desc: Hoping to get closer as a family, Gomez, Morticia and the rest of the Addams clan embark on an adventurous road trip in a hideous and humongous camper.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: The Spengler family returns to the iconic New York City firehouse with the original Ghostbusters. When an ancient artifact unleashes an evil force, Ghostbusters new and old must unite to protect their home and save the world from a second ice age.

programme.title: Hitpig!
programme.desc: A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realizes that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

programme.title: Heart Eyes
programme.desc: A masked maniac with glowing, red eyes returns every Valentine's Day to slaughter unsuspecting couples. When a cynical ad executive and her hopelessly romantic colleague become the next target, they decide to fight back and end the reign of terror.

programme.title: Dark Harvest
programme.desc: Teens confront a legendary supernatural specter that emerges from the cornfields of a small Midwestern town every fall.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

programme.title: Cora Bora
programme.desc: When Cora senses her relationship is in trouble, she puts her fledgling music career on hold to go home and win back her girlfriend. However, she soon realizes it's much more than her love life that needs salvaging.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: A government manhunt begins when a scientist boards a plane with the technology of a top-secret experiment in time travel.

programme.title: Whale
programme.desc: A young boy is sent to live with his grandparents in a remote indigenous community.

programme.title: Rush for Your Life
programme.desc: Journalism student Tasha goes under cover as a sorority pledge to expose the people responsible for the death of a student the prior year. She quickly finds herself completing dangerous hazing rituals to secure a spot in the sorority.

programme.title: Princes of the Desert
programme.desc: Zodi, a young Berber boy, befriends an orphaned baby camel and together, they journey across the Sahara Desert.

programme.title: Wild Goat Surf
programme.desc: In a run-down Okanagan RV park during the summer of 2003, surfing-obsessed 12-year-old skater girl Goat navigates the unbridled, unstructured summer days of youth, dreaming about becoming a surfer.

programme.title: The Amazing Maurice
programme.desc: Maurice is a streetwise ginger cat who comes up with a money-making scam by befriending a group of talking rats. However, when Maurice and the rodents reach the town of Bad Blintz, their little con soon goes down the drain.

programme.title: The Garfield Movie
programme.desc: Garfield, the Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, finds himself on a wild outdoor adventure when his long-lost father draws him into a high-stakes heist.

programme.title: Crazy Racing
programme.desc: An adventurous teenager who is passionate about racing cars, is determined to win back a title that rightfully belongs to his family.

programme.title: Madame Web
